---
title: "ZLifts Dashboard"
format: dashboard
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
repo_root <- normalizePath(file.path(".."), mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(repo_root, "scripts", "source-analysis.R"))
source_zlifts(repo_root)

sets <- read_lifting_sets(file.path(repo_root, "data", "processed", "lifting_sets.csv"))
validation <- validate_lifting_data(sets)
session_progress <- summarize_session_progress(sets)

dashboard_payload <- dashboard_filter_payload(sets)
dashboard_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  dashboard_payload,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  digits = 12
)
dashboard_script <- paste(
  readLines(file.path(repo_root, "dashboard", "zlifts-filters.js"), warn = FALSE),
  collapse = "\n"
)

metric_workouts <- session_progress$total_workouts[[1]]
metric_sets <- session_progress$total_sets[[1]]
metric_reps <- session_progress$total_reps[[1]]
metric_volume <- session_progress$cumulative_volume_lb[[1]]
metric_latest <- session_progress$latest_workout_date[[1]]
metric_latest_volume <- session_progress$latest_workout_total_volume_lb[[1]]

validation_table <- validation |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Status = tools::toTitleCase(.data$status),
    Check = gsub("_", " ", .data$check),
    Message = .data$message,
    Count = .data$n
  )
```

# Overview

## Summary

```{r}
bslib::layout_column_wrap(
  width = "180px",
  bslib::value_box("Workouts", scales::comma(metric_workouts), theme = "primary"),
  bslib::value_box("Recorded sets", scales::comma(metric_sets), theme = "secondary"),
  bslib::value_box("Repetitions", scales::comma(metric_reps), theme = "success"),
  bslib::value_box("Total volume", paste(scales::comma(metric_volume), "lb"), theme = "info"),
  bslib::value_box("Latest workout", format(metric_latest, "%b %d, %Y"), theme = "warning"),
  bslib::value_box("Latest volume", paste(scales::comma(metric_latest_volume), "lb"), theme = "danger")
)
```

# Explore

## Filters

```{r}
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$script(
    id = "zlifts-dashboard-data",
    type = "application/json",
    htmltools::HTML(dashboard_json)
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "zlifts-plotly-dependency",
    style = "position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;",
    plotly::plot_ly(x = 1, y = 1, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", height = 1) |>
      plotly::layout(showlegend = FALSE, margin = list(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)) |>
      plotly::config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "zlifts-filter-panel",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "zlifts-filter-grid",
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `for` = "date-start-filter",
        "Start date",
        htmltools::tags$input(id = "date-start-filter", type = "date")
      ),
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `for` = "date-end-filter",
        "End date",
        htmltools::tags$input(id = "date-end-filter", type = "date")
      ),
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `for` = "exercise-filter",
        "Exercise",
        htmltools::tags$select(
          id = "exercise-filter",
          multiple = "multiple",
          size = "7",
          class = "zlifts-filter-select"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `for` = "movement-filter",
        "Movement group",
        htmltools::tags$select(
          id = "movement-filter",
          multiple = "multiple",
          size = "7",
          class = "zlifts-filter-select"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `for` = "equipment-filter",
        "Equipment",
        htmltools::tags$select(
          id = "equipment-filter",
          multiple = "multiple",
          size = "7",
          class = "zlifts-filter-select"
        )
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "zlifts-filter-actions",
      htmltools::tags$button(id = "reset-filters", type = "button", class = "zlifts-reset-button", "Reset filters"),
      htmltools::tags$span(id = "filter-status", class = "zlifts-filter-status", `aria-live` = "polite")
    )
  ),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(dashboard_script))
)
```
